messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell doctor who prescribes rosuvastatin if another doctor increases the dose of another medicine you are taking"
set: ["tell doctor who prescribes rosuvastatin if another doctor increases the dose of another medicine you are taking", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are taking apixaban", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "if stop for any reason, doctor may prescribe another medicine", "tell doctor if are pregnant", "tell doctor if are breastfeeding", "tell your doctor if you are of chinese descent", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using empagliflozin", "tell doctor if taking simvastatin", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "if you have switched from another anxiety medication", "tell doctor if you develop breathlessness", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking", "tell doctor if taking triptans for migraine", "ask doctor about taking medicine if pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
